AllStates.note: All seven kinds in a labelled legend: green open, hollow amber pending ring, red failing/closed, filled amber changes-requested, grey draft, pr-merged purple. Every tone opaque and distinguishable.

InWorkspaceRows.note: The workspaces-page usage — dot after the branch name followed by the PR number, in real card rows.
